items.source: Build the MockRestServiceServer and set up the underlying RestTemplate with a ClientHttpRequestFactory that creates mock requests.
items.translation: 构建 `MockRestServiceServer` 并配置底层的 `RestTemplate`，使用一个创建模拟请求的 ClientHttpRequestFactory。

items.source: Use the BufferingClientHttpRequestFactory wrapper to buffer the input and output streams, and for example, allow multiple reads of the response body.
items.translation: 使用 `BufferingClientHttpRequestFactory` 包装器来缓冲输入和输出流，例如允许多次读取响应正文。

items.source: An overloaded build alternative that accepts a custom RequestExpectationManager.
items.translation: 一个重载的构建替代方案，接受自定义的 RequestExpectationManager。

实质上是一个快捷方式：
builder.build(new UnorderedRequestExpectationManager)。

items.source: By default this is set to false
items.translation: 默认情况下，该值设置为false。

items.source: ignoreExpectOrder - whether to ignore the order of expectations

Whether to allow expected requests to be executed in any order not
necessarily matching the order of declaration.
items.translation: 是否允许按任意顺序执行预期请求，而不必匹配声明的顺序。
